1928, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 31 Cont July 27 Mrs. Mabel Jackson (46) 6012 Cooper Ave. Enrolled June 30th then hardly able to climb stairs - stoping every few steps - reports To- day as having no trouble with heart or breath since - now climbs 5 flights & works all day. Deo Gr.
July 29 Wojciek 7 - 3754 23rd St. Not able to stand weak-spined since 4 months old, enrolled May last year - at once seem to improve - now able to speak and quite ready to go to School
Mary Oc. 53 away from Church & Sacraments 30 yrs ... Enrolled three times last 18 months. + July 10 - Reconciled and rec'd Omnia. Deo Gr.
Page 32 July 30
Mrs. Louise Potrykus, 62, 4636 Dubois, Cancer of liver, hopeless. Proposes to enroll poor souls.
McGraw Fam. - 4 small child. - Father out of work.
Alice Duggan (40) 1535 20th St., Detroit. Enrolled on M- and 3 times thereafter for tumor operation - a cancerous groth. About a week befor SS. Heart Feast, she became hopelessly dying. Her sister promised a perpetual Enrollment if she were spared. - To-day July 30th reported coming O.K. "Miracle" Drs.
Meto Christot, helpless from accident in factory Jacob's. His son broke arm and Company refuses to do anything. Pray that something turn up in favor
Florence Retchuk 17 - Very Sick - down now for 9 mo's.
Mrs. A. Schneider, 2144 Harding Ave. Paralysed June 28 Enroled next day - 2nd stroke expected. On 3rd day - gets up and walks.
Page 33
Charles Mertens (37) Wife & 3 Ch'n - Capac, Mich. Auto Accident Unconsious 2 week with Fractured Scull - Doctors in St. Jo's Hosp- ital almost refused to accept - is enrolled May
Fred Lamond (58) 12332 Findley hopeless with inword goitre is En- rolled (May or June) improves at once. £ April 15th
